subject: Request: EU restore-trigger purge window exemption (MedCorps)
summary: Customer requests a limited exemption to the EU restore-triggered purge window to retain backups for an extended restore window for regulatory investigations. Legal and ops discuss scoped amendment to the DPA, subprocessor evidence, and a timeboxed purge exception with audit controls.
messages:
From: Danielle Ross <dross@medcorps-health.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Patio Cloud Sales <sales@patiocloud.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 16:12:00 +01:00
Subject: Request: EU restore-trigger purge window exemption (MedCorps)

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the demo last week. One follow-up ask from our compliance team: for a small subset of investigation cases we need the ability to restore backups that are otherwise scheduled for purge up to 45 days after the normal purge trigger. Our standard DPA allows a 30-day restore cushion but some regulatory investigations require a longer window.

Questions:
- Can Redwood grant a timeboxed exemption (45 days) for backups that are only restored for approved investigations?
- What evidence can you provide about subprocessors that touch backup snapshots for EU data?
- Would this require a DPA amendment or an addendum?

We are trying to avoid procurement delays so a limited-scope, auditable exception would help.

Appreciate a quick confirmation of next steps — we have a review call with legal on Thursday.

Thanks,
Danielle
Danielle Ross
Head of Compliance
MedCorps Health

Attachments: evidence_subproc_list_20250914.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Danielle Ross <dross@medcorps-health.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: EU restore-trigger purge window exemption (MedCorps)

Kimberly / Laura —

FYI: MedCorps is asking for a 45-day restore-triggered preserve window for EU backups (normally 30). They want it limited to approved regulatory investigations and auditable.

Key constraints I see:
- We need a clear scope (which environments, e.g., prod only) and a strict approval workflow (CS + Legal + Security signoff) so we don't end up extending retention broadly.
- Ops: whether a non-destructive "hold" is applied to snapshots or a delayed purge flag is used; both have cost implications.
- Subprocessors: they want evidence (who accesses snapshots, cross-border transfers).

Can Legal prepare a short amendment/addendum text we can present by Thursday? Ops (Priyom), can you sketch the operational controls and impact (cost, rollback, snapshot lifecycle) — include how long the exempted snapshots would exist and an audit trail.

I'd like to keep this timeboxed to a 6-month pilot if we can.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Danielle Ross <dross@medcorps-health.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 11:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: EU restore-trigger purge window exemption (MedCorps)

Karthik / Laura —

Thanks, Karthik. Drafting guidance: we can do a scoped DPA addendum that:
- Limits exemption to named account (MedCorps) and to production snapshots only.
- Requires a documented investigation request with legal and security approval before any restore is performed.
- Enforces a maximum 45-day hold from the original purge trigger, after which snapshots must be purged automatically.
- Requires Redwood to provide a subprocessor access log extract and the list of subprocessors for the affected snapshot objects.
- Includes an audit clause: customer can request a time-limited export of snapshot metadata and access logs for the investigation window.

I'll attach a short redline; this should be an addendum rather than a full DPA rewrite. If Ops can confirm the technical feasibility and the exact field names in the purge schedule CSV, I will circulate the addendum to MedCorps legal for signature.

Attaching: medcorps_dpa_amendment_v1.pdf (redline)

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Danielle Ross <dross@medcorps-health.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: EU restore-trigger purge window exemption (MedCorps)

Team —

Operational notes and the minimal viable controls for the 45-day restore-triggered hold:

1) Scope: production snapshots in EU region only (tagged: eu:prod). Non-prod and analytics snapshots excluded.
2) Implementation approach: add a "retain_until_override" flag at snapshot metadata level. When set, automatic purge jobs skip the snapshot until retain_until_override expires.
3) Approval workflow: Security+Legal must create a ticket in the incident-runbook board with a standardized template (we can add a checkbox for DPA-addendum required). Only the snapshot owner or Security can set the flag via internal ops tooling. All changes write to an audit log (immutable append-only events stored for 2 years).
4) Timeline & cost: incremental storage cost estimated at +0.08 USD/GB/month for retained snapshots; MedCorps estimated footprint is ~1.2TB for the scoped set.
5) Purge scheduling: default purge at day 30; with override the purge job will consider retain_until_override and will purge at day 45 automatically. No manual intervention to delete after day 45 to avoid drift.
6) Subprocessors: snapshots are stored on S3 in eu-west-1 and replicated to a restricted backup pool handled by CloudStor (subprocessor). We will provide the access log extract and a signed subprocessor list; CloudStor's processing is covered by our standard subprocessor contract.

I've attached a CSV with the relevant purge job fields (ops_purge_schedule.csv). We can support the audit export via a temporary signed URL delivered to MedCorps security.

If Legal signs off on the addendum text, we can provision the flag and approval template within 3 business days and stand up audit exports within 5 business days. 6-month pilot as Karthik suggested is doable.

Priyom Das
Senior SRE, Data Persistence
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ops_purge_schedule.csv

From: Danielle Ross <dross@medcorps-health.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 10:23:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Request: EU restore-trigger purge window exemption (MedCorps)

Thanks all — this is helpful.

MedCorps is comfortable with a scoped 45-day retained hold for EU prod snapshots with the following must-haves:
- Written addendum we can sign that says the hold is timeboxed and automated purge will run at day 45.
- Access log extract and subprocessor list (CloudStor) for the affected snapshots.
- Audit export capability for the investigation period.

If you can send the addendum redline and a short ops runbook we can present to our legal on Thursday, we'll be ready to sign quickly. Also please include an estimated monthly cost so procurement can pre-approve.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Danielle
